_doc: RADE manifest (contract: rhope-ops/RADE schemas/rade-manifest.schema.json). Built by the RADE engine through scripts/build_paste_bundles.py (a pinned shim, see scripts/rade.lock.json). Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild. A step may list "needs" (check ids in the engine's $checkDefs) and "estimate" (minutes, used until a real run time exists). "apps" is the embedded catalog the Choose screen lists (name, plain-English summary, step names); without it, one application has every step. A guide step may set "doneText" (its Done button) and "doneLog" (the log line on Done).

steps.name: T21 Check the test site is clean r11
steps.title: Check that the last round left nothing on the test site
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Removes a test list, library or Visitors member left by the last round. If an earlier round left a test person in PFM Office, this step reports FAILED and the last step removes them.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. Each removal runs even when an earlier one fails.
steps.doing: Checking that the test site is clean.

steps.name: T21 Make the probe list r11
steps.title: Make the test list and library
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the fake probe list (Visitors get Contribute on this list only) and library, uploads one fake workbook and writes the test page.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run changes nothing.
steps.doing: Making the test list and library.

steps.name: T21 Add the second person r11
steps.title: Add the second person to the test site
steps.note: A small window asks for the e-mail address of the second person. It stays on this computer. Adds that person to the site's Visitors group.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The address is never written to a file; the results show only yes or no.
after: T21 Make the probe list r11
steps.doing: Adding the second person to the Visitors group.

steps.name: T21 Ask for a new row r11
steps.title: Copy the link of the new row form
steps.note: Notes on this computer that this round asks the second person for a new row, and puts the link of the new row form on the clipboard. No sign-in.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Add the second person r11
steps.doing: Copying the link of the new row form.

steps.name: T21 Second person adds a row r11
steps.title: Ask the second person to add one row
steps.note: You need one person of your office for about 5 minutes, now. They open the new row form, type the title you send them and select Save. This test has waited 3 rounds for a second person.
guide: 1. Ask the second person to stay at a computer for about 5 minutes.
5. In the box "To", type the e-mail address you gave RADE for the second person.
7. Press Ctrl+V (the link of the new row form is on the clipboard).
8. In the chat box, type: Open this link, type T4a as the Title, select Save, tell me if it saved.
10. Wait for the reply: the row saved, or no permission.
If the person is not there yet: keep this card open. Skip only if nobody can help today.
after: T21 Ask for a new row r11

answers.prompt: What did the second person see?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: the second person tried a new row.

steps.name: T21 Read the test results r11
steps.title: Read the health, person and button results
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Reads the test list: did the second person save a new row? Changes nothing.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Second person adds a row r11

steps.name: T21 Remove the test list and library r11
steps.title: Remove the test person, list and library
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Takes the second person out of Visitors (and out of PFM Office if an earlier round left them there), and moves the probe list and library to the Recycle Bin. Runs after any failure.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. Each removal runs even when an earlier one fails.
steps.doing: Removing the test list and library.

steps.name: T16 Site logo r13: thumbnail
steps.title: Set the site thumbnail to the new logo
steps.note: You set the site thumbnail to the 90-161.Z logo in its Fulcrum colors (dark disc, cream ring, orange quill). The next card sets the header logo. About 3 minutes.
guide: 2. At the top right of the site, select the gear "Settings".
6. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
If the page is not your site: type the address you typed in the RADE box "Site address".
If there is no "Site logo thumbnail" box: select "It failed".
steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: set the thumbnail.
steps.url_source: Your site address, saved by RADE in Config\90161Z-site.txt when you typed it in the RADE box "Site address"; the placeholder is never opened when that file exists

steps.name: T16 Site logo r13: header logo
steps.title: Set the site header logo to the new logo
steps.note: You set the header logo of the site to the 90-161.Z logo in its Fulcrum colors (dark disc, cream ring, orange quill) and save both. The next step reads the logo back. About 3 minutes.
guide: 2. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
5. Look at the top left of the site: the Fulcrum logo must show.
steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: set the header logo.

answers.prompt: After Save, what did the site header show at the top left?
Did the thumbnail take the Fulcrum logo?

steps.name: T16 Read the site logo back r12
steps.title: Read the site logo back
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Reads the header logo of the site back. Changes nothing on the site.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
after: T16 Site logo r13: header logo

steps.name: T22 Open the 90-161.Z window r11
steps.title: Open the 90-161.Z window and do its 3 checks
steps.note: Opens your 90-161.Z window with fake data and saves a picture of each card. Do the 3 checks in the bar at the bottom. Feedback in the bar saves a comment on a card.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T22 Did the window open r11
steps.title: Check that the window opened
steps.note: Reads the result of the window step and opens nothing. Passes when the window opened, so the look questions run even when a check failed.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
steps.doing: Reading the result of the window step.

steps.name: T22 Answer: look and cards r11
steps.title: Answer 3 questions about the window look
steps.note: 3 questions about the look of the window. About 2 minutes.
after: T22 Did the window open r11

answers.prompt: Does the window look like your vision of the 90-161.Z app?
Did every card open and fit with no scroll bar?
What would you change first? One line, no names.
